recipes.title: Halal-cart chicken & rice
recipes.subtitle: Garlic-herb white sauce · warm chickpeas & carrots
recipes.description: Golden spiced chicken and yellow rice with a generous fresh mix of finely chopped lettuce and tomato, plus a loose garlic-herb white sauce. Warm lemony chickpeas and carrots alongside.

items: 200 g halal chicken breast, raw, skinless
80 ml water (or your rice packet's ratio)

ingredients.group: Garlic & herb white sauce — use all of it
items: 3 g garlic, crushed to a paste
45–60 ml cold water (start with the lower amount)
60 g cooked chickpeas, drained; unsalted or no-added-salt
100 g carrot, peeled and finely diced

ingredients.group: Fresh lettuce & tomato, plus shared seasoning
items: 60 g iceberg lettuce, very finely shredded, then cross-chopped short
1 g salt TOTAL, divided across chicken, rice, sauce and side (about a scant ¼ tsp fine salt; weigh if possible)

steps: Wash and dry the vegetables. Cut the tomato into thin slices, stack a few, cut into narrow lengths, then cross-cut into small dice as pictured. Roll the lettuce leaves loosely, slice into very fine shreds, then cross-chop into short, delicate pieces as pictured. Weigh the full fresh portion before plating. Mince the garlic; crush the sauce portion into a paste. Peel the carrot, cut lengthways into slim batons, then cross-cut into small cubes. Keep vegetables and raw chicken on separate boards.

Heat the oven to 210°C conventional / 190°C fan. Toss the carrot with its measured olive oil, smoked paprika and part of the reserved salt. Spread on a small lined tray. Roast for 20–25 minutes, turning halfway. Add the cooked, drained chickpeas for the final 5 minutes. Finish with the side's lemon juice and parsley; keep warm.

Rinse and drain the rice. Put it in a small, snug-lidded saucepan with the measured water, turmeric and a little of the reserved salt. Bring to a gentle boil, cover, then cook on the lowest heat for 10–12 minutes. Take off the heat and rest, covered, for 10 minutes. Fluff with a fork. If your rice packet specifies a different water ratio, follow that ratio.

Whisk the Greek yogurt with the sauce's garlic paste, finely chopped parsley, lemon juice and cold water. Add a little of the reserved salt and optional chilli flakes. Lift a spoon: the sauce should run off in a thin, continuous stream and settle flat in the bowl. If it still mounds or falls in dollops, whisk in extra cold water a little at a time, without exceeding the upper water amount listed. Refrigerate while the chicken cooks; stir and check the flow again before serving.

Pat the chicken dry. Cut into bite-sized chunks, then toss with the chicken's olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, coriander, oregano, black pepper and remaining reserved salt. Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken in one uncrowded layer. Leave for 2–3 minutes to colour, then turn and cook for about 5–7 minutes more. Lower the heat if the spices darken quickly. Check several of the thickest pieces with a food thermometer: they must reach 74°C. Rest for 3 minutes.

Taste the rice and carrot for tenderness. Stir the sauce again. If any cooked chicken pieces feel too large for a comfortable spoonful, chop them smaller on a clean board. Keep the lettuce and tomato fresh and cold until serving.

Put the finely chopped lettuce and diced tomato across roughly half the main plate. Spoon the rice onto the other half and add the chicken over it; keep the fresh vegetables visible and easy to scoop with each bite. Drizzle about two-fifths of the loose white sauce over the chicken and a little over the fresh vegetables; serve the rest in a small bowl. Serve the warm chickpea-carrot side in its own bowl. Bring all three dishes to the table together.

tl.description: Golden na manok at dilaw na kanin, may masaganang sariwang kamatis at pinong letsugas, at malabnaw na garlic-herb white sauce. Hiwalay ang mainit na chickpeas at carrot na may lemon.

items: 200 g halal chicken breast, hilaw at walang balat
35 g basmati rice, timbang bago lutuin
80 ml tubig (o ayon sa ratio sa pakete)

ingredients.group: Puting sarsa na may bawang at herbs — gamitin lahat
items: 45–60 ml malamig na tubig (magsimula sa mas mababang dami)

ingredients.group: Mainit na chickpeas at carrot — hiwalay na ihain
items: 60 g lutong chickpeas, pinatulo, walang dagdag na asin
100 g carrot, binalatan at pinong diced

ingredients.group: Sariwang letsugas at kamatis, at asin para sa buong recipe
items: 60 g iceberg lettuce, napakapinong hiniwa at pinaikli pa nang pahalang
1 g asin SA BUONG RECIPE, hatiin sa manok, kanin, sarsa at side (halos kulang na ¼ tsp pinong asin; timbangin kung maaari)

steps: Hugasan at patuyuin ang gulay. Hiwain nang manipis ang kamatis, patungin ang ilang hiwa, hiwain nang pahaba at saka pahalang para maging maliliit na dice gaya sa larawan. Irolyo nang maluwag ang letsugas, hiwain nang napakapino at tadtarin pa nang pahalang para maikli at manipis gaya sa larawan. Timbangin ang buong sariwang portion bago ihain. Tadtarin ang bawang; durugin pa ang para sa sarsa hanggang maging paste. Balatan ang carrot, hiwain nang pahaba at saka gawing maliliit na cube. Ihiwalay ang sangkalan ng gulay sa hilaw na manok.

Painitin ang oven sa 210°C conventional / 190°C fan. Ihalo sa carrot ang nakalaang olive oil, smoked paprika at bahagi ng asin. Ikalat sa maliit na tray na may baking paper. I-roast nang 20–25 minuto at baligtarin sa kalagitnaan. Idagdag ang lutong chickpeas sa huling 5 minuto. Ihalo ang nakalaang lemon juice at parsley at panatilihing mainit.

Banlawan at patuluin ang bigas. Ilagay sa maliit na kaserolang may mahigpit na takip kasama ang nakalaang tubig, turmeric at kaunting asin. Pakuluan nang mahina, takpan, at lutuin sa pinakamahinang apoy nang 10–12 minuto. Alisin sa apoy at hayaang nakatakip nang 10 minuto. Buhaghagin gamit ang tinidor. Kung iba ang water ratio sa pakete ng bigas, iyon ang sundin.

Haluin nang mabuti ang Greek yogurt, bawang na paste, pinong parsley, lemon juice at malamig na tubig na nakalaan sa sarsa. Dagdagan ng kaunting asin at opsyonal na chilli flakes. Itaas ang kutsara: dapat tuloy-tuloy at manipis ang agos ng sarsa, at pantay ang ibabaw sa mangkok. Kung buo-buo pa itong bumabagsak, unti-unting dagdagan ng malamig na tubig nang hindi lumalagpas sa pinakamataas na dami ng tubig na nakalista. Ilagay sa refrigerator habang niluluto ang manok; haluin at tingnan muli ang lapot bago ihain.

Patuyuin ang manok. Hiwain sa mga tipak na kasya sa isang subo at ihalo ang nakalaang olive oil, lemon juice, bawang, cumin, coriander, oregano, black pepper at natitirang asin. Painitin ang non-stick na kawali sa medium-high. Ilagay ang manok sa isang layer na hindi siksikan. Huwag galawin nang 2–3 minuto, saka baligtarin at lutuin pa nang mga 5–7 minuto. Hinaan ang apoy kung mabilis umitim ang spices. Sukatin ang ilang pinakamakapal na piraso gamit ang food thermometer: dapat umabot sa 74°C. Ipahinga nang 3 minuto.

Tikman kung malambot na ang kanin at carrot. Haluin muli ang sarsa. Kung may piraso ng lutong manok na masyadong malaki para sa kutsara, paliitin sa malinis na sangkalan. Panatilihing malamig at sariwa ang letsugas at kamatis hanggang ihain.

Ilagay ang pinong letsugas at diced na kamatis sa halos kalahati ng plato. Sa kabilang kalahati, ilagay ang kanin at ipatong ang manok; hayaang kita at madaling maisabay sa bawat subo ang sariwang gulay. Ibuhos ang mga dalawang-kalima ng malabnaw na sarsa sa manok at kaunti sa gulay; ihain ang natira sa maliit na mangkok. Ihain ang mainit na chickpea-carrot side sa hiwalay na mangkok. Dalhin nang sabay ang tatlong lalagyan sa mesa.

components.title: Chicken & yellow rice
components.body: 200 g raw chicken breast and 35 g dry basmati. Cumin, coriander, oregano and garlic; chopped into comfortable bites.

components.title: All the white sauce
components.body: 120 g of 2% Greek yogurt, loosened with 45–60 ml water, makes roughly 180–195 g of pourable garlic-herb sauce. Drizzle some and serve the rest alongside.

components.title: A proper fresh portion
components.body: 140 g tomato and 60 g lettuce: finely diced tomato and very fine, short lettuce shreds. Give the fresh vegetables roughly half the plate.

components.title: Warm chickpeas & carrots
components.body: A separate lemony, smoky side for fibre. This is the proposed side to try; flag it in Review if it doesn't appeal.

visual.adjustment: The chickpea side supplies much of this meal’s fibre. If the portion feels too much, flag it in Review so we can adjust gradually. Changing the side also changes the nutrition total.
visual.basis: Rounded estimates use generic USDA-style composition, raw chicken and rice weights, cooked chickpea weight and plain 2% Greek yogurt. About 18 g fat per dinner. Brands and cooking yields vary; this is not a lab analysis. Rice and chickpeas both count towards carbohydrate. Contains milk. This dinner has not yet been taste-tested.

nutritionCalculation.units: Generic estimates per 100 g; kcal, protein, carbohydrate, fat, fibre

components.title: Manok at dilaw na kanin
components.body: 200 g hilaw na chicken breast at 35 g tuyong basmati. May cumin, coriander, oregano at bawang; maliliit na tipak.

components.title: Lahat ng puting sarsa
components.body: Ang 120 g na 2% Greek yogurt, na may 45–60 ml tubig, ay nagiging mga 180–195 g na madaling ibuhos na garlic-herb sauce. Ibuhos ang bahagi at ihain ang natira sa tabi.

components.title: Masaganang sariwang gulay
components.body: 140 g kamatis at 60 g letsugas: maliliit na dice at napakapino at maiikling hibla. Ilagay ang sariwang gulay sa halos kalahati ng plato.

components.title: Mainit na chickpeas at carrot
components.body: Hiwalay na side dish na may lemon at smoky na lasa para sa fibre. Panukalang side ito; sabihin sa Review kung gusto mong palitan.

tl.adjustment: Malaking bahagi ng fibre ay mula sa chickpeas. Kung sobra para sa tiyan mo, sabihin para unti-unting ma-adjust; huwag basta alisin at gamitin pa rin ang parehong nutrition total.
tl.basis: Tantiyang nutrisyon batay sa generic USDA-style data, hilaw na timbang ng manok at bigas, lutong chickpeas at plain 2% Greek yogurt. Mga 18 g fat bawat hapunan. Nag-iiba ayon sa brand at pagluluto. Kasama sa carbohydrate ang bigas at chickpeas. May gatas. Hindi pa nasubukang lutuin at tikman.
